title: Larger of two
prompt: Return whichever of a and b is larger. If they are equal, return either one.
hints: Compare the two, and return a different one in each branch.
`if a > b:` return a, `else:` return b.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
